queries.sql:
WITH scope AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT b."ownerId" AS owner_id, b."workspaceId" AS workspace_id
  FROM public.bots b
  JOIN public.coordinator_bots c ON c."botId"=b.id AND c."ownerId"=b."ownerId" AND c."workspaceId"=b."workspaceId"
  WHERE b.id='d51efc47-1c61-4758-8c05-fd7a07e3d7b2'::uuid AND b."workspaceId"='4ae2a643-b09e-43eb-816c-1e5557bef170'::uuid
), recent_owner_runs AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT r.status FROM public.agent_runs r
  WHERE r."userId"=(SELECT owner_id FROM scope) AND r."createdAt">now()-interval '30 days'
  ORDER BY r."createdAt" DESC LIMIT 60
)
SELECT 'verified_scope' AS source, 'rows' AS state, count(*) AS row_count FROM scope
UNION ALL
SELECT 'workspace_bot_runs', CASE WHEN r.status IN ('queued','starting','running','stopping','waiting_input','paused','succeeded','failed','stopped','cancelled') THEN r.status ELSE 'unrecognized' END, count(*)
FROM public.agent_runs r JOIN public.bots b ON b.id=r."botId"
WHERE b."workspaceId"=(SELECT workspace_id FROM scope)
GROUP BY 2
UNION ALL
SELECT 'owner_recent60_runs', CASE WHEN status IN ('queued','starting','running','stopping','waiting_input','paused','succeeded','failed','stopped','cancelled') THEN status ELSE 'unrecognized' END, count(*)
FROM recent_owner_runs GROUP BY 2
UNION ALL
SELECT 'owner_factory', concat(CASE WHEN f.stage IN ('intake','plan','dispatch','execute','review','verify','repair','approval','publish','monitor') THEN f.stage ELSE 'unrecognized' END, ':', CASE WHEN f.status IN ('pending','running','waiting','passed','failed','blocked','cancelled','revoked','completed','succeeded') THEN f.status ELSE 'unrecognized' END), count(*)
FROM public.factory_tasks f WHERE f."userId"=(SELECT owner_id FROM scope)
GROUP BY 2
ORDER BY source, state

WITH scope AS (
 SELECT b."ownerId" AS owner_id, b."workspaceId" AS workspace_id
 FROM public.bots b JOIN public.coordinator_bots c ON c."botId"=b.id AND c."ownerId"=b."ownerId" AND c."workspaceId"=b."workspaceId"
 WHERE b.id='d51efc47-1c61-4758-8c05-fd7a07e3d7b2'::uuid AND b."workspaceId"='4ae2a643-b09e-43eb-816c-1e5557bef170'::uuid
)
SELECT f.id AS task_id, f."issueId" AS issue_id, f."botId" AS bot_id,
 f."botId"='d51efc47-1c61-4758-8c05-fd7a07e3d7b2'::uuid AS same_preflight_coordinator,
 f.stage, f.status, f.revision, f."createdAt" AS created_at, f."updatedAt" AS updated_at,
 f."attemptId" AS attempt_id, a."runId" AS attempt_run_id, a.status AS attempt_status,
 r.status AS run_status, r."createdAt" AS run_created_at, r."finishedAt" AS run_finished_at,
 f.reason='task_stalled' AS exact_task_stalled_reason,
 f.route ? 'watchdog' AS has_watchdog_metadata,
 (i.title ~ '^m1512-[0-9a-f]{16}$') AS matches_issue1512_fixture_title,
 EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.agent_runs r2 WHERE r2."retryOf"=r.id AND r2.status NOT IN ('succeeded','failed','stopped','cancelled')) AS has_unfinished_retry,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM public.factory_attempts a2 WHERE a2."taskId"=f.id) AS attempt_count
FROM public.factory_tasks f
LEFT JOIN public.factory_attempts a ON a.id=f."attemptId" AND a."taskId"=f.id
LEFT JOIN public.agent_runs r ON r.id=a."runId"
LEFT JOIN public.issues i ON i.id=f."issueId" AND i."userId"=f."userId"
WHERE f."userId"=(SELECT owner_id FROM scope) AND f.status='blocked'
ORDER BY f."updatedAt" DESC LIMIT 20

WITH scope AS (
 SELECT b."ownerId" AS owner_id FROM public.bots b JOIN public.coordinator_bots c ON c."botId"=b.id AND c."ownerId"=b."ownerId" AND c."workspaceId"=b."workspaceId"
 WHERE b.id='d51efc47-1c61-4758-8c05-fd7a07e3d7b2'::uuid AND b."workspaceId"='4ae2a643-b09e-43eb-816c-1e5557bef170'::uuid
)
SELECT b.id AS blocked_task_bot_id, b."workspaceId" AS blocked_task_workspace_id,
 b."workspaceId"='4ae2a643-b09e-43eb-816c-1e5557bef170'::uuid AS same_preflight_workspace,
 b."ownerId"=(SELECT owner_id FROM scope) AS same_account_owner,
 b."archivedAt" IS NOT NULL AS bot_archived,
 EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.coordinator_bots c WHERE c."botId"=b.id) AS is_coordinator
FROM public.bots b
JOIN public.factory_tasks f ON f."botId"=b.id
WHERE f.id='b2e96bca-9287-4ed7-92e7-68d9b8a3285f'::uuid AND f."userId"=(SELECT owner_id FROM scope)

limits: The three read-only statements are separate snapshots, not a transaction.
The final sixty recent owner runs are diagnostic; the acceptance driver separately keeps its wider active-run gate.
A historical blocked task is not universally terminal or safe to cancel.
No email, credential, prompt, message body, raw issue content or free-form reason was selected.
The diagnosis does not establish production trace acceptance.
